summary: KEPCO filed a Form 6-K to convene an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) on May 21, 2026. The sole agenda is the election of Kim, Tae-Ok as Standing Director, Comptroller Auditor General, and Audit Committee Member. The meeting will be held at KEPCO headquarters in Naju-si, Korea. Shareholders registered as of April 13, 2026 may vote. This is a routine governance item, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The filing updates foreign private issuer shareholders on a non-routine board election, comparable to a US proxy statement for director election.
